title: Urgency selection undefined for batched payloads with mixed hasMention values
description: When messages[] contains multiple entries with different hasMention values — some true, some false — the server must emit a single HTTP push request with one urgency level. The spec says 'use mentionUrgency for that delivery' when hasMention is true, but does not define what happens in a mixed batch. The spec should state that the server uses the highest applicable urgency across all entries in the batch (i.e., mentionUrgency if any entry has hasMention: true).
close_reason: hasMentionAll added as separate boolean; mentionUrgency fires when any entry in batch has hasMention or hasMentionAll true
